final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() <= keys.len() + 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level"], ["5"]) == ["fast", "5"]
  ex settings(["x", "mode"], ["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
  ex settings(["a", "a"], ["1", "2"]) == ["fast", "3", "2"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var other_keys: List[str] = []
  var other_vals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = copy keys[i]
    let v = copy values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = v
    else
      if k == "level"
        level = v
      else
        var found = False
        for j in range(0, other_keys.len())
          if other_keys[j] == k
            other_vals[j] = copy v
            found = True
        if found == False
          other_keys.append(k)
          other_vals.append(v)
  var res: List[str] = []
  res.append(mode)
  res.append(level)
  for v in other_vals
    res.append(copy v)
  res
